issues.description: The 12 legacy CropPulse crop entries have no rule-level agronomic source citations or local specialist decisions.
issues.required_action: Collect crop-specific primary evidence and scope it by crop, variety, location, season, and conditions; obtain qualified local review.

issues.description: The RwaSIS portal content, data export/API, geographic resolution, current rule status, and reuse terms were not accessible to this implementation.
issues.required_action: Obtain authorized, documented access and confirm scope and reuse conditions with RAB before extracting or redistributing data.

issues.description: Permissions for extracting, storing, or redistributing underlying RwaSIS and METEO RWANDA data products are not established by their public landing pages.
issues.required_action: Confirm product-specific terms, attribution, retention, and commercial-use permission with the issuing agency.

issues.description: The RwaSIS announcement describes testing status at its 2024 launch; it does not establish the current status or exact contents of recommendations.
issues.required_action: Verify current version, crop coverage, soil/UPI applicability, geography, trial basis, and current approval status directly with RAB.

issues.description: NISR SAS observations are aggregate historical statistics; structural checksum/schema validation does not independently validate survey estimates or make them agronomic guidance.
issues.required_action: Keep the statistics in the descriptive analytics path and do not cite them as proof of suitability, causality, fertilizer rates, or treatment efficacy.
issues.resolution: The recommender uses NISR history only as descriptive context; verified-source status requires NISR/SAS provenance rather than a generic validated flag. Regression tests cover ranking invariance, non-independent validation wording, and the prohibition on approved guidance activation (tests/test_recommender.py and tests/test_backend_api.py). Farmer-facing comparison displays dataset period, units, retrieval date, source, and limitations.

issues.description: No approved crop-specific rules currently demonstrate suitable coverage across Rwanda's 30 districts, seasons, varieties, soils, and production systems.
issues.required_action: Report evidence gaps by exact scope and do not claim national agronomic coverage until evidence and local review support it.
